subtitle: 船员陪同故事主线 · 五人演讲初版

slides.speaker: A
slides.title: 技术越来越强，文明怎样跟上？
slides.subtitle: 文明航程｜一段能对话、能行动、能回头看的文化旅程
bullets: 问题：技术能力与共同生活如何相处
载体：同一艘船、四个时代、八条历史航程
产物：有出处的碎片、人的选择、可见的文明成果
slides.notes: 【v07初版：本次未重新运行演示】大家好，我们展示的是文明航程。它从一个问题开始：技术越来越强之后，文明怎样跟上？我们把农业、工业、信息与人工智能四个时代放进同一个航海游戏。玩家不只是读知识，而是带着问题出发，亲手完成故事中的操作，决定技术怎样用于共同生活。接下来五个人分别从文化理解、路径比较、文明实践、产品演示和商业落地来说明。

en.title: As technology grows stronger, how does civilization keep pace?
en.subtitle: Civilization Voyage | A cultural journey from inquiry to action
bullets: Our question: technical capability and shared life
One ship, four eras, eight historical routes
Evidence, human choices and a visible civilization artifact
en.notes: [v07 draft: no new gameplay run for this revision.] Good afternoon. Our project is Civilization Voyage. We begin with a question: as technology becomes more powerful, how does civilization keep pace? The game follows agriculture, industry, information and artificial intelligence. Players do more than read facts. They discuss a cultural question, visit historical islands, operate small systems and decide how technical capabilities should serve shared life. Five speakers will explain cultural understanding, route comparison, civilization building, the actual product and its business case. Our central idea is that technology creates possibilities, while people remain responsible for the choices that shape a civilization.

slides.notes: 【v07初版：本次未重新运行演示】我们把三种内容分开：材料的历史背景，玩家和船员对材料的解释，以及游戏为了互动而创作的情境。比如治水传说不能当作有可靠纪年的史实，未来港口也不能说成已经发生过的事件。图片保留出处和授权，最后建成的港城明确属于创作。这样既能发挥想象，也不会让模型输出取代来源。

en.title: A source is a starting point, not a final judgment
en.subtitle: Separate historical material, interpretation and creative design
bullets: Label history, ancient legends and future scenarios
Keep image attribution and original references
Treat the rebuilt port as a creative artifact
en.notes: [v07 draft: no new gameplay run for this revision.] We distinguish three layers: historical material, interpretations of that material, and situations created for interaction. A flood-control legend is not presented as a securely dated event. A future port is not described as something that has already happened. Images retain attribution and links to their original sources. The port built at the end is clearly a creative artifact informed by cultural experience. This separation allows imaginative learning without letting either a model response or a game mechanic replace evidence. Players can revisit the original references and question the conclusions they draw.

slides.subtitle: 成本对应步骤，结论仍须看依据

slides.notes: 【v07初版：本次未重新运行演示】我们希望玩家比较的是，多看了什么材料，多检查了哪一个前提，以及最后的安排有没有照顾到被忽略的人。不同意见会留下来。等到航程结束，再用行动结果评估路径，这就是和而不同在产品里的具体体现。

en.title: Compare the work performed, then revisit the decision
en.subtitle: A higher price does not replace evidence
bullets: Keep different suggestions visible
Revise a premise when a counterexample matters
Judge the path through actions and outcomes
en.notes: [v07 draft: no new gameplay run for this revision.] The useful comparison is what additional work was performed: which materials were read, which premise was checked, and whether the final arrangement considered people who might otherwise be overlooked. Different suggestions remain visible. At the end, players revisit the route using their actions and outcomes. This is how we turn harmony without uniformity into a concrete product behavior.

en.title: Reflect, then return to the evidence
en.subtitle: Retrieval reopens the question

en.notes: [v07 draft: no new gameplay run for this revision.] Reflection returns the player to the material. The current build includes local keyword retrieval and an extractive summary with sources. When a model is connected, the retrieved fragments can be passed into a cited generated answer. Retrieval is not automatic fact certification. The goal is to turn a broad conclusion into a more specific question for the next voyage.

slides.speaker: E
slides.title: 把成本、密钥和失败都做成可管理的边界
slides.subtitle: 已实现的接入方式
bullets: Key仅留页面内存，经本机接口直连官方服务
每次请求由用户点击，显示真实Token用量
重复请求保护；超时不自动再次付费调用
slides.notes: 【v07初版：本次未重新运行演示】落地还要回答三件事：凭据放哪里，费用怎样看，出错怎么办。我们把密钥留在当前页面内存，不写进游戏存档、PPT或导出记录；请求经本机接口到官方服务。每次调用由用户点击，实际Token另记。重复请求有保护，超时后不会自动再调用一次。线路的准备补给和真实模型账单分开，这能让后续课堂预算与商业成本都保持可追溯。

en.title: Make credentials, cost and failure manageable
en.subtitle: Implemented connection boundaries
bullets: Keep keys in page memory; forward through a loopback gateway
Initiate each real request explicitly and record token usage
Protect duplicate requests; never automatically repeat an uncertain paid call
en.notes: [v07 draft: no new gameplay run for this revision.] Implementation also requires operational boundaries. Keys remain in page memory and are not written into game saves, presentation files or exported records. The loopback gateway forwards a request to the selected official provider. Each call is initiated explicitly, and actual token usage is recorded separately from game supplies. Duplicate requests are protected. If an upstream timeout makes the outcome uncertain, the product does not automatically send another paid request. These controls help teachers or future customers understand and manage spending. They also preserve an honest distinction between a reproducible local workflow and a live model-assisted session.

交付：课堂航程、教师引导、来源与反思记录

slides.notes: 【v07初版：本次未重新运行演示】我们的首批验证客群是大学通识、人文与AI工具课程。这是基于产品结构提出的客群假设，并不代表已经有学校合作。老师获得的是一条可组织的课堂航程、讨论引导和可复核的学习过程；学生得到的不是一份生成答案，而是一次带证据作出安排的经历。商业上先验证按班级或学期授权，再考虑文化内容包和文博轻定制。早期先解决老师是否愿意重复使用，而不是急着宣称规模化。

en.title: Validate one course before expanding the market
en.subtitle: Business plan | Target customers remain a hypothesis
bullets: First test: university humanities and AI-literacy courses
Deliver a classroom voyage, teaching prompts and evidence records
Test class/term licensing, then cultural content packages
en.notes: [v07 draft: no new gameplay run for this revision.] Our first customer hypothesis is university general education, humanities and AI-literacy courses. This follows from the product structure; it is not a claim that a university has already become a customer. Teachers would receive an organized classroom voyage, discussion prompts and an inspectable learning process. Students would receive an evidence-based experience of making a decision, rather than just a generated answer. We would first validate class or term licensing, then consider cultural content packages and limited customization for cultural institutions. Early on, repeat use by teachers matters more than an unsupported story about immediate scale.

slides.speaker: E
slides.title: 一张能改参数的试点账表
slides.subtitle: 情景测算，不是服务商报价或收入预测
bullets: 试验报价假设：999元/班·4周，40人
1920轮 × 0.03元/轮假设＝57.6元模型成本
再计审核、支持与运维；单独看成本敏感性
slides.notes: 【v07初版：本次未重新运行演示】为了让BP可以讨论，我们提供一组可替换的情景参数，不把它当成已验证定价。假设四十人上四周，每人每周十二轮，共一千九百二十轮。若每轮平均模型成本假设为三分钱，模型部分是五十七点六元，再加内容审核一百六十元、支持八十元和运维二十元，总可变成本三百一十七点六元。假设试验报价为九百九十九元，贡献余额为六百八十一点四元，尚未扣研发、获客和税费。真实试点要用导出的Token与工时替换这些假设，并看高成本情形是否仍可承受。

en.title: A pilot model with editable assumptions
en.subtitle: Illustrative economics, not a provider quote or revenue forecast
bullets: Assume CNY 999 per class: 40 students over four weeks
1,920 interactions × CNY 0.03 assumed average cost = CNY 57.60
Add review, support and hosting; test cost sensitivity
en.notes: [v07 draft: no new gameplay run for this revision.] To make the business plan discussable, we provide replaceable assumptions. Assume forty students, four weeks and twelve interactions per student per week: that is one thousand nine hundred and twenty interactions. At an assumed average model cost of three fen each, the model component is fifty-seven yuan and sixty fen. Add one hundred and sixty yuan for content review, eighty for support and twenty for hosting. Total variable cost is three hundred and seventeen yuan and sixty fen. Against an experimental class price of nine hundred and ninety-nine yuan, contribution is six hundred and eighty-one yuan and forty fen, before development, acquisition and tax. These are not validated prices. A pilot must replace the assumptions with actual token usage and labor, and test the higher-cost scenario.

访谈教师：是否愿意再用、愿为哪项价值付费

slides.notes: 【v07初版：本次未重新运行演示】下一步我们希望招募一门课做小范围试点。先看学生能否走完、来源能否回溯、反思能否把证据和判断分开，再问老师愿不愿意重复使用，愿意为什么价值付费。用真实调用和审核工时更新成本，符合预设门槛再扩展。我们的核心观点是：技术提供能力，文明需要共同的判断；文明航程把这件事变成可以亲手做、也可以回头检查的过程。

en.title: Let a verifiable pilot determine the next step
en.subtitle: Technology enables; shared judgment shapes civilization
bullets: Test completion, source traceability and evidence-based reflection
Ask teachers whether and why they would use it again
Update the business case with actual usage, labor and feedback
en.notes: [v07 draft: no new gameplay run for this revision.] The next step is a small course pilot. First ask whether students can complete a voyage, whether references remain traceable, and whether reflection separates evidence from judgment. Then ask teachers whether they would use it again, and which value they would pay for. Real usage and review time should replace our cost assumptions before expansion. Our conclusion is simple: technology creates capabilities, while civilization requires shared judgment. Civilization Voyage turns that relationship into something people can act on, inspect and reconsider.
